data.one_liner: A widget that allows nested scrollable widgets to overscroll their parent.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package that allows nested scrollable widgets to overscroll their parent scrollable widget seamlessly. It maintains smooth scroll behavior and ensures that parent and child scrollable widgets interact correctly. It supports inertia and touch scrolling animations.
use_when: You have nested scrollable widgets that need to overscroll their parent.
You want smooth scroll behavior between parent and child scrollables.
avoid_when: You do not have nested scrollables.
You do not require overscroll effects between nested scrollable widgets.
strengths: Enables nested Scrollable widgets to overscroll their parent scrollable.
Customizable scroll physics for all nested scrollables.
Supports inertia and touch scrolling animations.
weaknesses: Initial release (version 0.0.1) with limited community testing.
Not documented for advanced configuration beyond basic wrapping.
